acceptance: After the parser fix merges: rerun DuckDB TPC-H SF 0.1 with plan capture, replace its bundle, companion and manifest in PR 4127, regenerate the inventory, re-cut the ledger seed and update CORPUS_NOTES
The owner lifts the hold on PR 4127 and it merges; the site deploy completes
Live snapshot: sum(has_plans) and sum(plans_published) are at least 2; both /results/data/bundles/<id>.plans.json return 200, parse and have no local paths
Both detail pages show the plan viewer and Download plans, with page text captured
context:
Commands that worked (run in a linked worktree, absolute paths, no $ in CMD):
1. make heavy-run CMD='BENCHBOX_OUTPUT_DIR=<abs out> uv run -- benchbox run --platform duckdb --benchmark tpch --scale 0.1 --phases generate,load,power --capture-plans --compression zstd:9 --non-interactive > <abs log> 2>&1' (same with --platform polars-df). No --seed: a seeded DataFrame TPC-H run is validation uncertain and is skipped by staging; DuckDB SF 1 --official --seed 42 fails at export (duckdb-tpch-sf1-official-export-row-count-contract-20261111).
2. BENCHBOX_OUTPUT_DIR=<abs out> uv run -- benchbox publish run <result.json> --target <abs dir> --label unofficial-research (sanitizes the companion; default label refuses subscale). Remove the local record afterwards with benchbox publish remove -y <id>.
3. make corpus-stage-local RESULT=<published bundle> OUT=<abs staging dir>
4. uv run -- python scripts/validate_submission.py --require-manifest --trust-internal-source <staged bundle>
5. Copy staged files to results-data/bundles/, uv run -- python scripts/generate_corpus_inventory.py --write, uv run -- python results-data/validate_corpus.py, make ledger-seed-recut.
6. Local Explorer check: uv run -- python _project/scripts/explorer_publish.py build --data-dir <dir with bundles/> --output <out>; both rows had has_plans and plans_published true and were ranking-eligible; ids tpch-duckdb-sf0.1-20261111-0318de15 and tpch-polars-sf0.1-20261111-27561037 (the DuckDB id will change on rerun).
Verified on the staged bytes: 22 plans each, 0 capture failures, DuckDB 22 fingerprints, Polars 0; find_public_path_leaks and unanonymized_plans_findings empty for bundles and companions; every measured row request_count 1.
Path after merge: Trunk on develop, site-inputs.yml builds the bundle and dispatches core-bundle to BenchBox-dev/benchbox-site, whose deploy.yml publishes to production; sync-results-data-to-published.yml opens a draft mirror PR onto published-results for the owner.
PR 4127 conflicts textually with open PR 3916 in publication/ledger-seed.json and results-data/corpus-inventory.json; regenerate both after whichever lands first.
Local record kept under ~/Developer/benchmark_runs/plans-publish/ (logs and raw run results).
Related findings filed the same day: polars-df-plan-capture-no-fingerprint-20261111, publish-run-rewrites-plans-companion-keys-20261111, maintainer-plans-bundle-path-docs-and-publish-refusal-20261111, heavy-run-cmd-dollar-expansion-20261111, seeded-dataframe-tpch-validation-uncertain-20261111.
description: Goal: at least one SQL and one DataFrame result live on benchbox.dev with has_plans and plans_published true, each serving a clean .plans.json, with the plan viewer and Download plans link on the detail page. State on 2026-11-11: live snapshot has 487 results, has_plans 0, plans_published 0. PR 4127 (branch chore/tpch-plan-capture-bundles, head 4e44ab50e6) adds TPC-H SF 0.1 bundles for DuckDB 1.5.5 (run a31c24ca) and Polars 1.44.2 DataFrame (run 3d7d3e84) with plans companions and internal manifests, the regenerated inventory, the re-cut ledger seed, a CORPUS_NOTES entry and a changelog fragment. The owner approved production publication of both, then put the PR on hold (no-auto-merge label) because the DuckDB companion carries wrong join types and sort directions from the parser defect this item needs. The owner decided the parser is fixed in a separate change, not as part of this publication.
